title: Rack Control Surface theme file (rcs-theme/2)
description: A custom theme for the Rack Control Surface panel and web view. Load it at Settings > System > Themes > Load theme file. Save it as <name>.rcs-theme.json.

name.description: What the theme is called in Settings. Runs of whitespace become one space. Empty or missing: "Custom".

title.description: Replaces "Rack Control Surface" in the browser tab, on the sign-in page, and in the web view header when there is no logo and no installation name. Empty: no replacement.

logo.description: Used by any version that has no logo of its own.

dark.description: Used while the unit is set to Dark.

light.description: Used while the unit is set to Light.

logo.description: A base64 data: URL of a PNG, JPEG, WebP or SVG image, at most 262144 bytes once decoded. The bytes must really be that type (PNG/JPEG/WebP magic numbers are checked; an SVG must contain an <svg element). Null or empty: no logo.

colors.description: Any colour left out (or null or "") comes from the built-in palette of the same mode. Unknown keys are ignored.

accent.description: Brand colour: selected items, primary buttons, focus. Text on it is chosen automatically (near-black or white).

logo.description: This version's logo. Overrides the top-level logo.
